title: Memory record (single recall predication)
description: One predication connecting an agent to a recently-touched entity, carrying a relevance value (a charge). Per lab/.../memory/memory-record/: a memory record IS a predication-graph entity that says 'agent A has recently encountered entity E with relevance R'.

relevance.description: Presence strength. A value corner (legacy bilattice path) OR a Q value in [0,1] (Q-enriched path; hacking/q-relevance, docs/GENEALOGY.md §6).
